text: There is no CSV output format; --format only accepts default, json, table and toon, so exporting to a spreadsheet needed a separate conversion step.
A numeric-looking string passed as a query parameter should stay a string, or the help should warn that it will be converted to an integer.
A numeric-looking string parameter was silently converted to an integer, so a lookup on a string property returned no rows and no warning.
Credential environment variables were present but ignored until accept-env-vars was enabled; the hint explained it, but the default was surprising.
LOAD CSV guidance should explain where local files must be placed.
The query command failed with a usage error that did not say which flag was invalid.
See https://neo4j.com/docs/operations-manual/current/ for the documented behavior that differs from the CLI.
Setting accept-env-vars in config.json had no effect until the CLI was restarted.
The error returned Neo.ClientError.Security.Unauthorized without saying which credential source was used.
The help for --max-rows should mention the default of 100 more prominently.
The command took several seconds to start on every invocation, even for help output.
NEO4J_PASSWORD was set, but the CLI still asked for --password in a non-interactive shell.
The --format flag help says (default: false) for a string option, which is confusing.
A note in the help (note: experimental) did not say what would change.
The command printed Error on auth: unauthorized without naming the credential source.
When the token: expired case happens, the message should say how to log in again.
The release asset for x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu was missing from the list.
The skill refers to neo4j-cli-aura-instance-create-v2, which no longer exists.
The --param flag syntax is not explained for lists.
The SKILL.md and README.md disagree about the install.sh options.
Settings in neo4j.conf were not reflected in the CLI output.
It suggested a Next.js example that does not use the driver.
The $NEO4J_URI variable was ignored when --uri was absent.
The help should explain CALL IN TRANSACTIONS with LOAD CSV for large imports.
Typing the /mcp command in the agent did not list the CLI.
The docs compare it to std::string handling, which was unclear.
It used retry:10 in the message but did not retry.
The help	text used a tab where a space was expected.
See https://github.com/neo4j-labs/neo4j-cli/issues for the existing report on this.
